decision_needed.question: Governmental funds show net transfers in of 277,724 while business-type activities show transfers out of 287,724 (the 10,000 difference goes to the component unit CRA). Is recording the governmental transfer as net 277,724, as printed, acceptable?

notes: Governmental funds use the modified cash basis and business-type activities the accrual basis; basis recorded as cash. Governmental statement lines come from the Total Governmental Funds column (p5), as printed (Intergovernmental and Grants and contributions kept as single lines). Bond proceeds 5,250,000 are inside printed total revenues 8,278,172 and are recorded in debt_proceeds. Roll-forward: 3,613,206 + 3,028,172 - 8,859,703 + 277,724 + 5,250,000 = 3,309,399 (total fund balances). Business-type statement lines come from the Total column of the proprietary statement of revenues, expenses and changes in fund net position (p9; Internal Service Fund column excluded); roll-forward 7,947,451 + 2,698,032 - 2,404,160 - 287,724 = 7,953,599. Proprietary cash flows from the Total column (p11). Business-type detail by fund: Light and Water (p8), Sewer and Trash (p9). Governmental net position from the Statement of Activities (p3). Balance sheet = government-wide Statement of Net Position (p1), governmental and business-type columns (together the Total column); component unit excluded. General Fund detail is department-level from the budget schedule (p13). Read pages 1-19 of 19
